nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing Night Serum Capsules

avis.texte: I just started using this, but I love how soft my skin feels so soft. Roc has great products, so I'm positive that I will get good results from this.

I use it 3x's a week. Instructions to start most retinol are less often then you gradually increase (don't use it every day). I apply night cream on top afterwards to help with dryness (I read that somewhere). It helps. Fine lines gone. 46yo

I have been using this for over 4 months I do not see any changes on my fine lines
Live in a very dry climate. Don't use it every night but 3-4 times a week. Makes a huge difference.
I've tried several retinol products and this one actually feels like it is working already!

avis.titre: I love how this product works.

I just love this product. When I go to bed at night my skin feels like silk. When I wake up in the morning. My skin looks so refreshing, smoothness hydrated. Beautiful texture, I just love this product. And recommend this highly

Skin is smoother and lines are not a prominent. Has an immediate greasy feelings that disappears after a few minutes. I find one capsule is too much, so I use 1/2 a capsule each time. You will not regret buying this!!! It works beautifilly fir fine lines, it is unscented and safe for acne prone skin, and ither than the price is a bit high, there is jot one bad thing to say about this product. I highly recommend it!!!

Love this!! Consistency is key. Take a before picture of face - closeup on texture, wrinkles any problem areas. You will feel a difference in texture within a week! Then after you finished the product take the same pictures again and you will be amazed. I was shocked at how nice my skin looked! People even complemented how smooth ans bright my skin looked. (I also used the retinol complection face cream at the same time)

avis.titre: Love oil based hydration this gives with line reduction
avis.texte: I Love the RoC line since trying the travel sizes to see if I can use with sensitive skin. These Retinol Night Capsules have been great at reducing fine lines and love the oil in it that hydrates my face as well, great product. My skin Loves it too!

tried this for the first time and I love it. my forehead wrinkles have been annoying me and I've been using it for not even a full week. I just started using it Saturday (it's currently thursday) and I've noticed a significant difference! the formula does feel a little greasy to me at first when I put it on but it's not causing breakouts or anything and the greasy feel goes away. honestly that part is just me being weird and picky i think.

I am a ROC product user and have decided to incorporate this product into my routine. I have been using it for over two weeks now and absolutely see a radiance and smoothness in my skin and it feels amazing.

This is the first time I purchased this product. I had a sample and tried it. I liked how my skin felt the next morning. After using this a few nights, I'm liking the overall appearance and texture of my skin. Am I seeing fewer lines? Not sure, maybe yes on my neck—and that's a plus!! I think I'm starting to see a subtle difference on my face—but there weren't as many obvious ones to look for. That said, it leaves my skin feeling smooth, soft and supple. Just nice the next morning. So yes,, will be buying again.
Went to work the next day after 1 application and was told my skin is glowing. I have very sensitive skin, this weather and my hard water destroys my skin - I'm not dry or irritated from this!

I'm 27 years old & my sensitive/combo skin loves this stuff! I had been using this brand's eye cream for a while & noticed a significant difference in my dark circles, dryness, & fine lines around my eyes. I've also been struggling with hormonal acne & I had tried several retinol products but never really been "obsessed" or ever noticed a huge difference in my skin - then I started using this! I can use each capsule twice, so I use half of the product one night & then save the rest for the next night. I have noticed such a difference in the overall texture & discoloration of my skin. This along with their eye cream has been the ultimate dynamic duo for my sensitive, combination skin.

This makes my skin feel so good. When I wake up in the morning my skin looks and feels amazing. I only use half of the contents of one capsule at night. That is plenty for me, so it lasts twice as long!
I am really loving the ROC products. These capsules work really well so far. I have used them less than a week, but so far I am pleased with the way my skin has improved.

avis.titre: EARLY BREAKOUTS ARE SIGN IT IS WORKING
avis.texte: This is a really, really great retinol product. A few reviewers mentioned this broke them out "because its too oily", and while everyones skin is different, thats likely not the case. Retinol is known for frequently worsening skin before improving it. Your skin needs time to adjust to the ingredients and benefits of a product. I highly urge people to (consult your dermatologist ) but continue using it after the first breakout. My results from using this product every-other night, per the directions, have been wonderful.
After using these for 2 weeks I can see a huge change. My dark spots have lightened and my skin is brighter and looks firm. I would recommend!

I'm 23 I learned that after age 25 your skin starts to lose collagen etc. so I decided to start using retinol early. I used it for half a year so far and my skin looks smoother and less wrinkly. I use it in combo with roc blue capsules. best overtime

Just used for first time and I already love it. First put the blue HA cap on then the R cap. Love the silky texture and light scent. A bit oily though, probably only for couple times a week will use though, too oily for nightly use. Love the convenience of capsules!!
Since it's super oily it made my forehead break out bad! With so many red and white bumps. Will be trying something less oily. The retinol in this is below 1% anyways.

My fave!!!! Highly recommend!!! I'm in my 40's. I've been using Roc for a couple of years. No one thinks I'm 40. Helps with fine lines and skin tone, delivering promised results, and it's budget friendly! I use all their products and am happy with them all.

I cannot believe the difference that this product made with my existing wrinkles! This retinol is the real thing and works beyond belief! I have never seen such a dramatic difference as when used along with the RoC deep wrinkle filler. I use this in the morning and wear under my makeup and it works as a great primer for my foundation and other makeup. This product really works!

I am a skin care junkie and have tried dozens of brands in the past but the results I have seen with the ROC brand has far surpassed any other brand I have tried. I have been using these capsules along with the retinol correxion max hydration cream and the retinol correxion line smoothing eye cream for over 6 months now and I have absolutely seen a dramatic improvement in my skin, especially my fine lines and wrinkles. I have struggled with my make-up settling into my wrinkles for some time now, especially between my eyebrows, but since using these products, that has improved tremendously. I am constantly being told my skin looks amazing and I even had another mom tell me everytime she sees me, my make-up looks flawless. I 100% attribute that to my skincare routine. The key is consistency, you will not get the results you want if you are not using these products consistently. I also had an esthetician explain to me that using products from the same line or brand will give you better results than using products from multiple brands. I appreciate ROC for developing high quality products, while also being super affordable for the average person because EVERYONE deserves to have great skin!
I've been using this product 2x a week for two months & definitely see a difference. My face is clearer & looks fresher! ✌🏽
I've only used it twice and am already noticing a difference. I struggle with acne scars and wrinkles (around my eyes) and it's already significantly helped with skin texture and the wrinkles.
Ulta service has gone down hill. I received a trial size of this product and decided to buy the full size. It is sooo much smaller and completely different. I do not recommend. Waste of money

First time retinol user here. Using EVERY SINGLE NIGHT, for 1 Mos. I did not even use the sandwich method for this, and it was gentle enough for me being a newbie to use every night. there were 2 nights after the first 2 weeks where my lips and sides on my nostrils were sore from it, but I doubled up the night cream and morning moisturizer to avoid it happening again. it's not greasy, is silky, no scent. I mean this from the depths of my soul.... my skin didn't even look this good as a teen. I'm 32. I'm obsessed with this. include this in your normal skin routine... you will not believe the change.

This product is great. It comes in small capsules you pop open. I wish there were more in the bottle but that's a mild complaint. The product is smooth and not oily. No distinct smell. Easy to open. I mix with a gentle moisturizer and use every night. As a first time retinol user, I've had no sensitivities or issues using it this way, and I've seen a great improvement in my skin texture and firmness. Can I bathe in this?

I love this retinol capsules. It feels so fancy and the texture of the serum is so comforting and calming. It's like a serumy oily consistency but it feels so soothing on the skin. I just really enjoy smearing this on my face and my face always feels plumbed the next day.

I've been using this for about a month and a half and I can see a HUGE difference. I have bad acne scaring on my cheeks and I can see the texture of my skin has improved 100% since using. The scaring (pockmarks) have significantly diminished. I highly recommend this product.

I have very sensitive skin and have several autoimmune diseases that affect my skin. I have to be careful with what I can use. I began using this product and instantly loved the way it felt on my face. The next morning my face already felt better than it had in years. I've been using this for over a month. My face feels softer and is less red than it normally is (from my autoimmune diseases). I hope they never change the formulation.

This is a great retinol product - a few tips for those not used to using retinols in their routines. This should only be used at night as during the day you need to use sunscreen to protect the skin. Retinols are light sensitive and should not be used when going out for the day. Protect your skin with at least SPF 15 when using this product to avoid sun damage. Also, the greasy-like feel of the product goes away after about two minutes once absorbed. Do not apply any serums to your face after using retinol - the retinol will look your skin's barrier and the serum will not penetrate well. You should also avoid using makeup immediately after applying retinol as this requires time (at least 5 hours) to be effective and cleansing later to remove the make up will negate the effects

So I got these for my neck/décolleté area. I do think they're pretty strong as I've noticed I can really only go every other evening otherwise I get irritation—similar to the prescription cream I use on my face. What I like about these is that each application is hygienic due to the individual capsules, and it does feel moisturizing as it's a heavier serum (but bc of irritation I do sometimes layer a moisturizer on top). I also like that there is no scent. However, I have used these for a solid three months and have really not seen any noticeable improvement in fine lines. I'll probably continue using as a preventative measure against future/additional lines, but it didn't do much for what was already existing.

Love the pre measured portions, environment friendly packaging, and that the ingredient list in minimal but impactful. Acne prone aging skin, will be 40 in a couple years, doesn't break me out, feels lovely, and I do see some improvements with texture after having used for about 6 months now. There is no such product that will truly reverse visible aging, preventative care is key, and feel this is a great add to the arsenal to manage my post/acne and aging concerns. Very cost effective, especially if able to find good sales/deals and considering. Super easy to apply, and I found that applying to my neck then face is the best way to maximize amount of serum to cover (when I start with face first, always feels like I don't get enough on neck). Don't forget the neck y'all!!! :-)

I use this 1-2 times a week at night. I have normal/dry skin and this has dramatically improved my skin texture! (Along with my other skin care) This leaves me feeling dewy and hydrated in the mornings and after using for five months I can tell a huge difference in my complexion.

So I am only about 2 weeks in and I know typically with OTC retinol products visible results can take about 4-6 weeks. That said, I can't really comment on how much it helps fine lines. I got these for my neck/décolleté as I am 29 and can see that area beginning to age. The formula is very hydrating so I'm pleased with that effect—when I wake up in the morning my skin is definitely soft. That said, I think the formula may be too heavy. When I apply it my skin is visibly greasy and even an hour + later it still looks that way so it doesn't feel like it's being absorbed. I think I'll continue using as a moisturizer but I don't have high hopes beyond that given that it doesn't appear to be going very deep.

I use it every evening( if u r new to retinol, you should start with few nights a week) and I love how it feels and looks in the morning! The capsules are great and easy to use, don't need to buy travel size separately!
i got this as a free sample and i've been using it every other night. plan to invest in the larger size... these are great!
Bought these because they were on sale. After applying, makes my skin feel kind of greasy with an obvious shine on my face. Doesn't work/do anything for me.
This product will provide hydration which you can see and feel immediately. I will continue to use (pm only).
This little capsule of youth does wonders ..been using for a while now and I see a difference in my skin .this stuff is a must in your nightly skincare routine.
I use this every night after taking off my makeup & washing my face!
One of my favorite retinols. This shrunk my pores a lot and i struggle with large pores so this was the only thing that actually helped me.

Started late to the skin care game so I was using Perricone and then Drunken Elephant products which did help.. but at this price point this stuff is just as if not more effective! Been using for a week & my skin looks great. Lip lines definitely diminished!

Ok all, after searching for an effective moisturizer to help counter my onset of aging signs I have FINALLY found something. I have tried things anywhere from 50-over 100 dollars. All of which delivered minimal results. I actually, finally noticed a result after my first tub of Roc. I was very much missing my natural 'glow'. You know, the skin that has a natural highlight and luster? I had really started to lose it. My skin was starting to look dry and just blah. Roc certainly restored this. I am 40 years old. I highly recommend this product.

I was using a different retinol serum and decided to give this one a shot after I ran out. Omg, I've been using it for about a week now and it's a fav so far!! I, unfortunately, I have bad genes and don't have great skin. I have large pores, uneven tone, scars, hormonal acne! Name it, I got it, haha! Was even told once by an esthetician that I needed to work hard to have decent skin. Anyway, I have noticed a difference with this product. No, I haven't woken up with small pores and perfect skin, but there is an all around improvement to my skin that's hard to pinpoint. My flaws are still there, but I definitely see that my scars and uneven skin tone are not so prominent and there's a glow I've never seen with any other product. Rambling aside, I highly recommend! And it feels so luxurious when you put it on. Love this stuff!

I was getting bad maskne for a while but using one of these every other night (too greasy for daytime) has cleared me up in less than 2 weeks. I used this in conjunction with witch hazel and Pacifica's sea foam face wash.

avis.titre: I loved it I definitely would buy it again

I got this to try for free from punchme. I gave it to my mom because I don't have a lot of wrinkles yet. I noticed it really helped to smoothen out my moms fine lines & wrinkles. I definitely think this is a great product.

I received a FREE product sample from PINCHme. I used this every other night so as not to dry out my combination skin.l It works well and leaves my skin looking smoother.

avis.titre: Consistency is the key to great results!
avis.texte: I received this product free from PinchMe for my honest review. I have used 28 of the 30 capsules so far. During the first week I was a little worried because I actually thought my skin was looking worse, but at day 7 I started to notice a positive change in the fine lines around my eyes. I have continued to use the product every evening and definitely feel like my skin looks more youthful with far fewer fine lines. I have very few deep lines, but the product didn't really change those, so don't count on being completely wrinkle free with just this product. I don't love the scent as it smells a little like spoiled oil, but the product works well, so I would consider purchasing to use regularly.

I have used prescription strength Retinol in the past, and I expected RoC RETINOL CORREXION Line Smoothing Night Serum Capsules to provide similar results. It did not. I used as directed at night for a month, and did not see an appreciable difference in my skin, especially regarding my forehead lines and naso labial folds. It is also very greasy and smells like cooking oil that has gone off. It fully absorbs by morning and softens skin, but mot much more. In addition, areas of my skin began peeling (although I moisturized after use) which is undesirable in the morning, as I must exfoliate again before cosmetics application. If not, I have dry skin peels through the makeup, horrifying! Worst of all, I use mousse self tanners. I do not have sensitive skin, but this product caused hypersensitivity so badly that I felt as though I had rug burn all over my face after application. If you do decide to buy this, I recommend powdered bronzers only to achieve a sun kissed look as well as sunscreen, as Retinols increase sun sensitivity. Overall, this product was not for me, and I will continue using prescription strength retinol as before. Many thanks for the FREE SAMPLE that was provided to me, so that I could share my product experiences with you!
